_comment: Golden set for evaluating AI categorisation models. Copy to golden_set.json, replace with ~50-100 of your own anonymised real transactions hand-labelled with the category you'd accept, then run scripts/eval_categorization.py. 'categories' must mirror the categories that exist in the app you are evaluating for (name + description). Each transaction's 'expected_category' MUST be one of those names. 'importance'/'exclude' are optional per row; include 'exclude': true (with a matching ai_rule) for the destructive-exclude cases that matter most.

categories.name: Groceries
categories.description: Supermarkets and food shopping. Not restaurants or takeaway.

categories.name: Food & Drink
categories.description: Restaurants, cafes, pubs, takeaway, food delivery.

categories.name: Transport
categories.description: Public transport, fuel, taxis, rideshare, parking.

categories.name: Shopping
categories.description: General retail, clothes, household goods, electronics.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.description: Gas, electricity, water, broadband, mobile phone bills.

categories.name: Health
categories.description: Pharmacy, dental, medical, gym and fitness.

categories.name: Transfers
categories.description: Money moved between own accounts or to savings. Not real spending.

ai_rules: Transfers to a savings account should be excluded.
Coffee under 6.00 is essential, not discretionary.
